entities.name: Venus Pharma Kft
entities.type: step-down subsidiary of Venus Pharma GmbH (Hungary)

operating_notes.text: Saudi FDA approved Plerixafor 24mg/1.2ml for sale in Saudi Arabia through Venus Remedies' existing international business network, focused on tertiary oncology centres.
FY26 consolidated EBITDA margin was 20.77% against 12.94% in FY25, with R&D held flat at ₹18.17 Cr.
Venus Pharma GmbH (Germany) contributed ₹26.84 Cr revenue and ₹3.48 Cr PAT in FY26; its accounts were under audit at the reporting date.
The company has one reportable segment, Pharmaceuticals.
Secured five marketing authorisations across Kazakhstan, Peru, Kuwait and Argentina for Vancomycin, Fluorouracil, Fulvestrant, Methotrexate, and Meropenem.

holders.name: ACADIAN EMERGING MARKETS MICRO-CAP EQUITY MASTER FUND
INVESTOR EDUCATION AND PROTECTION FUND AUTHORITY MINISTRY OF CORPORATE AFFAIRS

timeline.summary: Pawan Chaudhary (Promoter/MD) and group declared no encumbrance or pledge of Venus Remedies’ equity shares as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Venus Remedies received Saudi FDA Marketing Authorization for Plerixafor 24mg/1.2ml, its first approval for the molecule in any market.
Venus Remedies reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹769.60 Cr and PAT of ₹102.78 Cr, recommended a ₹10 final dividend, and set the AGM for 20 August 2026.
Venus Remedies secured five marketing authorisations across Kazakhstan, Peru, Kuwait, and Argentina.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹218.76 Cr (+13.5% YoY), net profit ₹25.65 Cr (+27.4% YoY).
